items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Queen Wilhamina had said -- because she had, the proclamation that she had surrendered -- she spoken French and all that and what she said, she said, please do not hurt my black population.

ctx.x: Now here's where I said well, if they are going to do me in, I'm going to get pretty I decided -- well, I got my suit on and so, I was -- what do you call the big hotel there -- the Metropole They are saying all this Dutch and, the Dutchland so, they said, all citizens stay in the house.

Queen Wilhamina had said -- because she had, the proclamation that she had surrendered -- she spoken French and all that and what she said, she said, please do not hurt my black population. Don't hurt my black population.

So, about two days, they come in there and they had them white suits on, every man was the same, they was soldering. They come in there, and they played "Deutschland uber Alles" (inaudible), and there was hailing and going on, and I was right -- when the big man come out of the car, I was right there so he could see me right there.
